sources.provider: Philippine Statistics Authority, Cavite Provincial Statistical Office
sources.accessStatus: Official release page and linked technical-notes PDF text reviewed online. The release PDF returned a cache miss and Annex A timed out in the browsing tool; no attachment was downloaded or retained.
sources.reuseStatus: The release page footer states CC BY 4.0 unless otherwise stated. Attachment-specific terms were not independently checked; this review does not grant app publication approval.

sources.title: Cavite Commercial Fisheries Preliminary Situation Report: 1st Quarter 2026
sources.provider: Philippine Statistics Authority, Cavite Provincial Statistical Office
sources.accessStatus: Official release page text reviewed online. Linked technical notes and Annex A and B returned cache misses; no attachments were downloaded or retained.
sources.reuseStatus: The landing page carries the PSA CALABARZON CC BY 4.0 default footer unless otherwise stated. Attachment-specific terms remain unverified; no derived species assertion is approved for the app.

coverageAndMethods.commercialSurveyContext: The related QCFS release says commercial vessels operate beyond municipal waters and describes estimates by species and fishing ground. The accessible narrative provides province-level production and selected common labels; no fishing-ground-specific values or locality geometry were reviewed.
coverageAndMethods.preliminaryStatus: The technical notes state that current-quarter data are preliminary and may be revised after additional reports and validation. Details may differ from totals because of rounding or statistical disclosure control.

inlandMunicipal.label: Tilapia
inlandMunicipal.resolution: Common category; no scientific species name or specimen identification supplied.

inlandMunicipal.label: Mullet (Kapak)
inlandMunicipal.resolution: Common/local label; no scientific species name or specimen identification supplied.

inlandMunicipal.label: Mud Crab (Alimango)
inlandMunicipal.resolution: Crustacean, not a fish; common category, not species-level identification.

sourceReportedCatchLabels.labelPolicy: Retain PSA source wording as fishery-production labels. Do not resolve broad common names to binomials or treat these labels as a checklist. Squid and mud crab are aquatic catch categories but not fish.

inlandDefinitionCrosscheck.CaviteTechnicalNotesWording: Inland municipal fisheries refer to municipal fishing activities conducted in inland brackish waters.
inlandDefinitionCrosscheck.PSAQIFSCollectionWording: The PSA QIFS catalog describes inland waters including lakes, rivers, dams, marshes, swamps, irrigation canals, and creeks.
inlandDefinitionCrosscheck.decision: The difference in wording is unresolved. Do not assign the Cavite inland-production categories to a particular freshwater lake, river, reservoir, or brackish site from this release.

spatialAndTaxonomicResolution.interpretation: Official provincial catch production helps prioritize follow-up but does not identify a fish occurrence in a named waterbody, current local presence, ecological abundance, catchability, diet, safety, legal access, or geometry.

decision.use: Current official Cavite fisheries-production context and a search-prioritization hint for separate site-resolved sources. Keep subsectors distinct and labels verbatim.

nextAction: Continue locality-resolved research for named CALABARZON rivers, lakes, reservoirs, wetlands, estuaries and coastal sites. Use PSA production categories only to prioritize candidate source searches; obtain site, date, identification basis, and reuse terms before considering any waterbody species claim.
